ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Heat conditions restrict the types and distribution ranges of crops. Read the figure and answer: <image1> If by 2100 global warming is 4°C-5°C, the rice planting area in China’s Sanjiang Plain will ____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the vertical axis represents “growth rate,” and the horizontal axis represents “temperature.” The curve shows that crops can grow only between the lowest temperature and the highest temperature; before reaching the “optimum” temperature, when temperature rises, the growth rate generally rises, and after exceeding the optimum temperature, the growth rate declines. Then reason: The question stem says heat conditions restrict crop types and distribution ranges. The Sanjiang Plain is located in China’s northeastern high-latitude region, and rice planting is mainly restricted by insufficient heat and a relatively short frost-free period. If by 2100 global warming is 4°C-5°C, the heat conditions in the Sanjiang Plain will improve and be closer to the temperature range suitable for rice growth, so the plantable range of rice will expand, and the planting area will also expand.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中横轴为温度、纵轴为生长速度，作物在最低温度到最高温度之间才能生长，且在未达到最适温度前，温度升高会使生长速度提高。再读题干：热量条件制约农作物种类和分布，情境为到2100年全球增温4°C-5°C，考查我国三江平原水稻种植面积。结合地理知识：三江平原位于我国东北高纬地区，当前水稻生产主要受热量不足、无霜期较短限制；增温会改善热量条件，使其更接近水稻适宜生长温度范围。因此可推断水稻可种植范围和面积将扩大。
